definition: The occurrence and development of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way.
example: Finding my dream apartment while taking an unfamiliar street was pure serendipity.

definition: Fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing.
example: She delivered an eloquent speech that moved the entire audience.

definition: Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions.
example: Children can often be remarkably resilient in stressful circumstances.

definition: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a practical way.
example: We decided to take a pragmatic approach to cutting unnecessary expenses.

definition: Open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning.
example: The final contract clause was somewhat ambiguous and required legal clarification.

definition: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
example: The architect gave meticulous instructions on every structural measurement.

definition: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another.
example: Great leaders demonstrate strong empathy towards their team members.

definition: Work jointly on an activity or project to produce something.
example: Designers and engineers collaborate closely during product sprints.

definition: Present, appearing, or found everywhere.
example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern metropolitan life.

definition: Induce someone to do something through reasoning or argument.
example: She managed to persuade the investors with a solid presentation.

definition: Certain to happen; unavoidable.
example: With the rise of internet banking, cashless stores became inevitable.

definition: The quality of being open, sincere, and honest in expression.
example: I appreciated his candor when reviewing my initial design draft.

definition: Expressed clearly; easy to understand.
example: The professor gave a remarkably lucid explanation of quantum physics.

definition: A sentimental longing or wistful affection for a period in the past.
example: Hearing that nostalgic music brought back memories of childhood summers.

definition: Having or showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties.
example: Through diligent study every evening, he mastered English in one year.

definition: Able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.
example: He is a versatile programmer capable of building both mobile and cloud apps.

definition: Lasting for a very short time; fleeting.
example: The ephemeral beauty of cherry blossoms draws millions of tourists.

definition: Having knowledge or awareness of something.
example: We must remain cognizant of cultural differences when traveling abroad.

definition: Of undisputed origin and not a copy; genuine.
example: This small local bistro serves authentic Italian pasta dishes.

definition: Tending to keep a firm hold of something; clinging or persisting.
example: Her tenacious spirit ensured she never gave up despite setbacks.
